description: The clue points to a political background that is difficult to pry into. The investigators discuss the pros and cons and plan a more indirect investigation route.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... Another sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Holy moly!" #Shivers

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... Another sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "This scene feels somewhat familiar to me."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Looks like a torture chamber, is this really what you wanted?" #Raises the lighter high, gas is sufficient, turns it to maximum to provide light for her, helps out with the other hand.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .ra Spot

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire, if it's what you wish for, it will be answered, <player5>'s Spot Prayer:

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Looking around, "Tsk tsk, like a horror movie scene, wonder what the corpse looked like before it turned into bones."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire, if it's what you wish for, it will be answered, <player12>'s Spot Prayer:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Johnson notices a faint glow coming from a room deep inside.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .ra Archaeology

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire, if it's what you wish for, it will be answered, <player5>'s Archaeology Prayer:

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Huh? Is that fluorescent stone? Still glowing, hey miss, look at that." #Points at it, curiously approaches the glowing area.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Hmm, let me see what that is."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: In this prison cell, dozens of glowing roses bloom among piles of bones. Emerald green petals drip black pus, violet-colored flower hearts extend filamentous pistils that pierce into the eye sockets of skulls. Orange roses emerge from between rib gaps, grass-green buds pulsate like hearts within chest cavities. Among the intertwined thorns of the roses, you see a statue's left arm lying horizontally atop a pile of bones.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "What is this thing?"

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Oh! Look at that, isn't that the statue fragment you said you were looking for? Looks really weird." #Points at that statue left arm.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Glowing roses, and that seems to be the statue."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "You don't have to tell me, it's weird. This is a stone cell, there's no soil, how can flowers bloom?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The roots of the roses emerge from cracks in the walls or floor.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "And it's not even rose blooming season, it's the middle of winter."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Simultaneously sniffs to see if there's any strange fragrance here.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The scent of roses.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: .st show Throw

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player12>'s currently registered personal information is as follows:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st show Throw

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player5>'s currently registered personal information is as follows:

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #First picks up a stone and throws it into the black pus to see the effect.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Take out the dagger and try to clear out a dirt pit within 5 meters of the rose.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The stone draws a parabola and falls into the black, pus-like rain threads, sizzling like meat frying in hot oil. A fist-sized rock collapses into a honeycomb shape within three seconds. A vine-like whip suddenly lashes out at the stone, smashing it against the adjacent stone wall into powder.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Wow, what a fierce flower."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Take a sharp, deep breath, heart skipping a beat.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Johnson frantically throws his spear at the rose bushes, hitting a skeleton. The splintered bones scatter like popping corn kernels.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Thinking about how I never really believed in God since childhood, being dragged to church by Old John to celebrate the old man upstairs's birthday. But seeing this living flower for the first time in my life, I couldn't help it. The twisted, horrifying scene floods my eyes, reshaping my worldview. After throwing the spear, Johnson feels dizzy and lands on his butt.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Take a deep breath. Although aware that putting a blood-covered wound directly into the soil is prone to infection, I have no choice but to do it.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Oh, my dear Satan. Before, when you talked about that unbound flesh cult using magic, I didn't believe a word. Now it seems... I've gotten myself into something big." #Turns pale with fright, looking at Professor Bailan.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Ah, what comes next might be a bit..."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Okay" #Obediently closes eyes.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Ignore any consequences, plunge both hands into the soil, silently recite that ancient, wordless incantation, as always, like an admonition no one understands.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Well, I'm not squeamish about blood, but bleeding like this isn't good either. After we get out, maybe find that doctor to take a look?" #Asks with eyes closed.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st mp-10 san-1-1d4

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player5>'s "Sanity" change: 51 ➯ 49 (deduct -1-1d4=-2)

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st mp-10

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player5>'s "Magic Points" change: 2 ➯ -8 (deduct -10=-10)

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st mp1

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player5>'s coc7 attribute registration completed. 1 piece of data updated this time.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Oh, clatter clatter, what's growing?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: As the humus under Professor Bailan's hands emits a green fluorescence, the roses in the room instantly wither into ash. The emerald vines dry up and snap like snakes drained of blood. Six massive arms covered in fluorescent moss burst forth from the earth.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Control those arms, grab that statue, and bring it to my side.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Darkness deprives Johnson of sight, and fear floods in doubly through other senses: the skeleton makes eggshell-cracking脆响 under the tentacles' squeeze. Mycelium on the ground crawls up your calves, bringing a prickly itch. The mycelium oozes a swamp-bottom-like stench. (.sc 1/1d4)

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: You successfully obtain the arm. The arm is smooth, seemingly ordinary, like porcelain, only cold to the touch. The porcelain-like surface has repeating strange patterns.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Hiss, a bit itchy. Miss, when can I open my eyes? I'm feeling a bit spooked. It's too dark."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Pull hands out of the soil, wipe everything off hands with a handkerchief.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Instinctively shift backward a bit

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Only after all the strange phenomena completely disappear do I speak up to remind, "OK, you can open your eyes now."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Suddenly, the faint gray mist in this room condenses into a milky white vortex without warning, the gas stinging everyone's corneas like ice needles. Your vision is temporarily swallowed by the blinding milky white. After regaining sight, you find the mist sliding along the stone wall toward the exit, picking up half a tattered veil as it passes the torture rack, the fabric fluttering in the airflow like...

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Opening my eyes to see the statue has already moved. "Wow, it really is magic, ha, haha." Force a dry laugh, avoiding Bailan like avoiding a ghost, quickly pick up the spear.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "We can leave now."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: Goodness, got stuck with a few divine beings... #Mutter to myself and follow along.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player12>'s "Sanity" change: 62 ➯ 65 (increase 1d4=3)

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Dragging my body, exhausted from vomiting, I leave

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: You walk out of the basement, exit the courtyard gate, and find player2 helping player4 walk while thanking the doctor at the house door

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: .st san＋1d4

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: <player5>'s "Sanity" change: 49 ➯ 52 (increase 1d4=3)

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Walk around to the door, call out to the doctor, "Sir, can you take a look at this lady's injury? She accidentally cut her hand."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Not a big impact, just need a little treatment to prevent infection."

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "A ready-made doctor is right here, what's the harm in taking a look? It's not like I'm paying anyway" #Blink my eyes

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The doctor walks over to check the situation, goes back inside, fetches a medical kit, and disinfects and bandages Bailan's wound.

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Doctor, please help" #Force a smile

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Extend my hand, waiting for the doctor to bandage it

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "All done and auspicious, so can you help me with the ID and passport matters?" #Plead on the way, clasping hands together and shaking them

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Old Louis flicks the frost particles off the carriage seat with his whip tip, the chestnut horse snorts white mist and tries to nibble the moss on Johnson's coat. Whoa! He yanks back the reins—this old buddy thinks you're a mobile hayfield! Your next leg of the journey is... back to the Ritz for a calming drink, or...

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "For God's sake"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Request received! Continuing to record the horror of the Orient Express for you. Currently recorded text: 5837 entries, time elapsed: 28 hours, 42 minutes, 0 seconds

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Last time we left off, you obtained the left arm statue.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Call Old Henry and ask him to give us another ride to the town hall

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Time to go." #Wrap the statue well and place it in the suitcase

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Pale-faced

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Pat player4's head "I'll buy you ice cream later"

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Then let's evacuate. Right, what's in hand won't run away" #Nod and go find Old Louis to get on the carriage

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Old Henry pats Lightning's neck and shouts, "Let's go!" The carriage creaks and starts moving, heading forward along the cobblestone road. After turning a few corners, the carriage stops at the town hall square. The square is bustling with people, newspaper-selling children running around.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Take Henry Johnson to the front desk

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Get off the carriage, excitedly rub my hands together

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Silent

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Looking at his clothes

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Size isn't an issue, it's about maintaining upper-class 'propriety'" #Suppressing a half-smile

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "In his state, anything I say is useless"

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "When I have money, I'll pay you back for the dry cleaning" #Rubbing hands excitedly.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Wishing my handbag had clean clothes

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player2 did bring spare clothes

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Slapping forehead "Look at my memory"

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Taking it and changing out of work clothes right there, putting on the new shirt and pants.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Looking him up and down

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Let's go in then, the waistband is a bit tight."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "The hair is still a bit..." #Thinking for a moment, but it can be explained

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player2 and Johnson enter the town hall, the marble floor feels cool underfoot. A bespectacled woman sits at the front desk, looking up to ask what they need?

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "I'm player12, here to reapply for my passport and ID documents, lost them previously"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The woman hands over two forms Fill these out first, the pen next to it is in an inkwell.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Zoning out

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: #Taking the forms, looking them over, dipping the pen for ink and filling out the information quickly.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Having Henry fill out the form first

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The bespectacled woman takes the forms, pushes up her glasses, examining them carefully. Mr. Johnson, right? She pulls out a thick registry book, occupation listed as locksmith, please pay a 20-franc processing fee. She points to a small metal box on the counter, already containing a few banknotes.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Leaning on the counter, speaking quickly and politely "It's like this, miss"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The woman puts the 20 francs in the box, a slight smile curling her lips upon seeing the extra tip. Thank you, sir, she says, taking a brass number tag from a drawer. Please take this to the photography room on the second floor, come back in three days to collect the passport after the photo. She places the tag on the counter, metal lightly clacking against wood.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Thank you, miss"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Thanks"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Following behind

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Alright, alright" #Taking the number tag and quickly going to take the photo, returning to regroup

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Leading Johnson back to the carriage, storing his worn-out clothes properly

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Mr. player2, we really owe you"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Just a slight understanding"

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "That's right, a section of tunnel collapsed"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "We still have over three days"

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Transporting a bunch of building materials Pétain used for his villa, all junk."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Do you think there's still time to save people now?"

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Cleaned up, destroyed the evidence."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #shrugs "These things do happen sometimes."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Uh... I think it's hard for us to help them."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Tasiga you."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "The Marshal definitely won't see us, right?"

conversation.speaker: player12
conversation.text: "Everything's settled, maybe we should go to the Orient Express first and ask the attendant if the train will be suspended because of this?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I also think there's no need to delay here any longer."
